run_simulation: run a GPU request scheduling simulation with a router policy, scheduler policy, and list of simulated requests
create_simulation_result: create a simulation result containing step records and a summary dictionary from a completed simulator run
build_gpu_state: build a GPU state object that tracks running requests, pending requests, and token capacity for one GPU
test_router_policy: test the router policy interface that assigns incoming requests to specific GPUs in the simulation
review_scheduler_policy: review the scheduler policy interface that decides which pending requests to run on each GPU step
